item.text:
Hi [Organizer’s Name],

Could we consider choosing a route with more benches for our next walk? Having regular places to pause would make the outing more comfortable and welcoming for participants with different mobility levels, stamina, or health needs. It could also help anyone who simply wants to rest, enjoy the scenery, or chat along the way. A route with several seating options would let more people join confidently and participate at a pace that works for them.

Best,  
[Your Name]
